searchText: What do you think we need to get done or vetted before we cut a release? constant iteration is going to begin to defeat our standardization purposes Personally, I'd like to get the events sorted out. There is an open PR for it but I need to go back and provide more justification. The only other thing that I can think of that isn't already present in a PR would be moving the submission of attestations to accept an array rather than the current single attestation. I can raise a PR for that in the next few hours. Just written up https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/pull/102 which discusses moving attestation submission from one attestation per request to an array of attestations. Also added another comment to https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/pull/96 regarding state events. If this stuff is off-base then happy to discuss, but given the previous conversation on this I _think_ we need something like this for validator clients to work properly.
